instruction: Put the yellow pen in the green pen case.

attempts.code:

obs = observe()
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
candidate = candidates[0]  # Use the first grasp candidate
grasp(candidate)
spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_yaw = spot["object_long_axis_yaw"]
grasp_yaw = candidate["yaw"]
delta_yaw = target_yaw - (grasp_yaw - candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"])
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=None)
rotate_by(delta_yaw)
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
